synopsis: ASAM OpenSCENARIO DSL 2.2.0 is dated 19 March 2026 [f7152, f14486]. Its first-class support for abstract and logical scenarios, parameter variation and key performance indicators suits scenario families, and the booklet rates its off-road fit as moderate [f14486, f7153, f14487]. That fit is constrained by an on-road domain model, shared with the cited OpenSCENARIO XML and OpenDRIVE standards [f6691, f7154, f14487]. Tool support is limited; the cited 2026 preprint addresses compiling OpenSCENARIO 2.1 for CARLA, rather than establishing support for DSL 2.2.0 [f7155, f7152].

relations.note: Both identify first-class scenario concepts as suitable for scenario families.
Both state that DSL has an on-road domain model.
Both report limited DSL tool support.
Both rate DSL's off-road fit as moderate.
Both identify DSL's domain model as road-oriented.
Provides the exact March release date for version 2.2.0.
Places DSL's road-oriented model alongside XML 1.4.0 and OpenDRIVE 1.9.0.
Scenario-family capabilities explain the positive component of the moderate off-road rating.
Adds a 2026 CARLA compilation preprint concerning OpenSCENARIO 2.1.
